title: Uncertainty-Aware NBA Forecasting: RNN + Monte Carlo Dropout (MDPI 2026 SOTA)

sources.paper: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sources.key_result: RNN+MC dropout Brier ~0.20, LR+XGBoost baseline also ~0.20

sources.paper: Comparing Machine Learning Methods for NBA Game Outcome Prediction
sources.key_result: LR Brier ~0.199-0.20, AUC 0.75-0.76 — already in vm-add-logistic-regression-model-pool

sources.paper: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues

architecture.model: Recurrent Neural Network (LSTM/GRU) with Monte Carlo Dropout
architecture.uncertainty_mechanism: MC dropout at inference: N=50 forward passes → mean prediction + epistemic uncertainty estimate

key_findings.vs_fleet_best: Fleet best 0.22012 vs SOTA 0.20 = 0.020 headroom (~9% improvement)
key_findings.lr_baseline: LR+XGBoost baseline also achieves ~0.20 — CPU-actionable today
key_findings.uncertainty_value: Confidence bounds enable variance-adjusted Kelly sizing: lower stake when MC variance is high

cpu_actionable.action: Add logistic_regression to all island MODEL_TYPES

action_1.name: MC Dropout RNN for NBA
action_1.description: Train LSTM with MC dropout on 11440 games + temporal features. At inference, run 50 forward passes to get uncertainty estimate.
action_1.platform: Modal A10G (auto via .github/workflows/modal-burst.yml) or Kaggle P100

action_2.name: Shot-Chart CNN Embeddings
action_2.description: Train CNN on shot-chart heatmaps → 128-dim embedding as GA feature. Requires shot-chart data ingestion (browser-use scraper or public API).
action_2.dependency: shot-chart data pipeline not yet built

betting_application.insight: MC dropout outputs a DISTRIBUTION P(home_win), not just a number
betting_application.kelly_upgrade: Kelly fraction = f(edge, uncertainty) — when MC std_dev is high (0.15+), cap stake at 50% of normal Kelly
betting_application.expected_roi_impact: Lower variance → better Sharpe ratio even at same Brier score
betting_application.implementation: Modify _calculate_kelly_fraction in TF agents to accept confidence_bound parameter

cross_project_note: Same uncertainty architecture applies to Political Alpha. pol-oracle Brier 0.23274 — MC dropout could push toward 0.20 target.
verdict: PRIORITY-1 for next GPU burst. LR addition is immediate CPU win (today). MC dropout RNN is medium-term GPU target (Modal A10G). Shot-chart embeddings are longer-term.
